verdict.rationale: The quickstart says existing OpenAI SDK users only need to point the client at Requesty, with 'No SDK changes, no new client to learn'. It shows base_url swapped from api.openai.com/v1 to router.requesty.ai/v1, and llms.txt describes the product as an OpenAI-compatible API. Standard OpenAI-style endpoints such as chat completions and /v1/images/generations are documented, which supports drop-in use beyond basic chat. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that unmodified OpenAI code works; the API-key swap is implied rather than shown in the cited snippet.
